posts.title: Fare Inspectors? Holy Wow, They Exist!
posts.description: Kicking off Thanksgiving week with a sighting I hadn't had in years: a fare inspector on Link between Overlake and Capitol Hill. Plus some thoughts on the unspoken schedule of fare evasion, and the theater of order we all ride along with.

posts.title: Test Run: Bellevue to Tacoma on the Early Cascades
posts.description: A dry run of the early morning transit trek from Bellevue to Amtrak Cascades at King Street Station, then down to Tacoma, checking out the new trainsets' power sockets, seats, bike racks, and ride quality along the way.

posts.title: Every Bus, Train, and Ferry in Puget Sound — On One Live Map
